en: Luke 18

p.src: 1  He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

p.src: 2  saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

en: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.
u.src: 2  saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

p.src: 3  A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

en: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

p.src: 4  He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

p.src: 7  Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

en: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

p.src: 9  He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

p.src: 10  “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

en: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
u.src: 10  “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

p.src: 11  The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

en: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

p.src: 12  I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

en: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

p.src: 13  But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

en: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

p.src: 14  I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

en: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

p.src: 15  They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

p.src: 16  Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

en: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

zh: 富足的官尋求永生之道

p.src: 18  A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

en: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
u.src: 18  A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

p.src: 19  Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

en: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

p.src: 20  You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

p.src: 21  He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

en: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

p.src: 22  When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

en: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

en: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

en: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

en: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
